text: I went to get my teeth cleaned (tartar removed), and the dentist was incredibly heavy-handed. My mouth was sore afterward (never before!), my gums were swollen and bleeding, with blood clots for two days. My mouth smelled of blood. I had booked an appointment, but when I arrived, they didn't do what I was scheduled for. I had to wait in line for almost an hour (what's the point of booking an appointment then?). Never again. It was the most agonizing teeth cleaning I've ever had. 🥲
